modal-icon/role-on-100.note: the modal's error glyph on its icon well

input-error/500-rim-vs-input.note: the invalid input rim at rest (the 500 pivot)

btn-default-danger/rest.note: quiet-danger ink on the default/outline variant's OWN ground

btn-default-danger/hover.note: the same on the 8% hover wash
